name: minipush
description: Mac mini 插件任务与推送中心

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json --noEmit
scripts.format: prettier --write src examples tests scripts *.json README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src examples tests scripts *.json README.md
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-packager build MiniPush --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=dist --overwrite --icon=src/ui/assets/MiniPush.icns --ignore=^/tests
